import re
import pandas as pd

def _validate_columns(df: pd.DataFrame, required):
    missing = [c for c in required if c not in df.columns]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f'Missing required columns: {missing}')

def _tokenizer(text: str):
    """Return list of alphabetic tokens in lower‑case."""
    return re.findall('[a-zA-Z]+', text.lower())

def main(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    required_cols = ['Month', 'Weekday', 'Year', 'Name', 'Ingredients']
    _validate_columns(df, required_cols)
    month_counts = df['Month'].dropna().value_counts()
    weekday_counts = df['Weekday'].dropna().value_counts()
    year_counts = df['Year'].dropna().astype(str).value_counts()
    stop_words = {'the', 'und', 'mit', 'ein', 'eine'}
    name_tokens = df['Name'].dropna().astype(str).apply(_tokenizer).explode().loc[lambda s: ~s.isin(stop_words)]
    name_counts = name_tokens.value_counts().head(5)
    ingredients_exploded = df['Ingredients'].explode()
    main_ingredients = ingredients_exploded.dropna().astype(str).apply(_tokenizer).apply(lambda toks: toks[0] if toks else None).dropna()
    ingredient_counts = main_ingredients.value_counts().head(5)
